review.notes: Full review of README.md (3246 lines) and Suggested.lean. Gate at this head: every check passed; depcheck 0 problems; lake env lean on Suggested.lean: sorry the only warning; one-tactic probe (simp, rfl, infer_instance) closes nothing. Seeded sample of 15 targets: 231 locators checked against the text (Stacks perfect, cohomology, more-algebra, divisors; Weibel K-book; BS17; Thomason 1985; Thomason93; Kal80; WeibelChern; GS87; LiLiu.2021; Totaro.2004), one wrong page (R08). Not verifiable: TT90, Soulé (Opérations), GS99, Quillen, Schlichting, Zhang.2021 (no legal copy obtained through the sources service; listed in scratch needs-references.toml), Gillet.1981 (uncertified). about 50 library declarations opened at the pins, about 145 cross-roadmap citations resolved in 17 roadmaps. Blocking: R01 (section 6.4, uniqueness of the lifted homotopy class does not follow: lim1 over finite ranks), R02 (van der Kallen stability of section 6.7 is statable at the pins and absent from Suggested.lean; replacement statement elaborated). P3: supplier names not found (IsCMRegular, FilteredSpectrum, ExactCouple), a ColemanIntegration target name not found, own Lean-style names not declared, an undefined term, five broken sentences, one page locator. Three source issues recorded (Weibel V.6.7.4, Weibel IV.5.7, BS17 proof of 11.2(2)).
